title: Sunday · the invitation on the table
logline: The drafting table from above: the cream cardstock, framed now, propped against the lamp; the dog's bed beneath; the sill's jars. The arc's Sunday: an object as a landscape.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the drafting table from above in morning light: the framed invitation propped against the lamp's base, a mug, a brush, the three jars on the sill at the top edge. Cream cardstock, a black frame, no mat.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a drafting table seen from above in morning light with a small black-framed cream invitation card propped against a lamp base, a mug, a brush, and three jars on a windowsill at the top edge, no words
image.notes: The frame: black, no mat — the 2001 kids' rule. The card's text unreadable.

panels.name: Table

panels.composition: Tier 2: the card, close, the letterpress deckle edge, two names in a script the strip refuses to letter, a date in July.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, close on a letterpress invitation card with a deckle edge behind glass, the script names rendered as illegible elegant marks, no words

panels.name: Card

panels.composition: Tier 3: beneath the table, the dog's bed, the dog in it, asleep, the frame's reflection in the floor's varnish above him. Held.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, an old dog asleep in a braided bed beneath a drafting table with a small framed card faintly reflected in the varnished floor, no words

panels.name: Bed

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The invitation as landscape. Names refused.
